item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your evening already has a wind-down built in: relaxation, a check-in, then a set bedtime. That structure is your advantage, so protect it. Tonight, keep screens out of the last stretch before lights out, and let the relaxation exercise do its job without multitasking. Consistent timing matters more than any single perfect night. Action: set an alarm for twenty minutes before bedtime, and start winding down the moment it sounds.
